svg.title: Arcadia logo usage, typography and color guidelines

g.aria-label: A useful identity for a daily quiz arcade.
An arcade entrance, reduced to an A.
The cut on its right foot suggests
a next step: return, learn, climb.
Keep the symbol flat and simple.
Use the outlined SVG as the master.
Leave at least 25% of the mark’s
Use white on violet or ink.
Use violet or ink on warm paper.
Do not stretch, tilt or add effects.
